title: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin out for rest of season with torn patellar tendon - NFL.com
description: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin will miss the remainder of the 2026 season after suffering a torn patellar tendon in Monday's loss to the 49ers, per head coach Dan Quinn.
